does_not_fit: The Apple Developer Program fee (USD 99, GBP 95.04 with 20% tax) breaches GBP 100 in whatever month it is paid, with every data tier, even Basic only (GBP 113.68 Virginia), and even in a dev-only month before paid data (GBP 101.36). The owner answered with a rule (owner_answers below): its month is the one allowed exception (GBP 141.52 Claude blocked, GBP 149.77 Claude A), and it is not bought for now.

Grow 79 monthly with Claude blocked: every month over GBP 70 and past the GBP 85 pause line (GBP 94.48).
Any annual data plan paid upfront: M1 GBP 774.01 (Grow 79) or GBP 295.93 (Grow 55), far over GBP 100.
The busy-month Claude stress (USD 74.88) breaks GBP 100 every month even with Grow 55 (GBP 118.36): the chat caps, not the model choice, decide this.
Grow 144: price unknown. It keeps ordinary months under GBP 100 only at or below USD 84.75 (Claude blocked) or USD 76.16 (Claude A), and under GBP 70 only at or below USD 53.50 or USD 44.91.
levers: Biggest: the data tier. Grow 79 to Grow 55 cuts USD 50, GBP 48.00 a month, every month.
Basic for dev: keeps one paid subscription; a second paid key for dev would add the full tier price again.
Annual data billing saves 17% but only helps cash if it can be paid monthly; paid upfront it is the largest single breach in the year. The page does not say which.
Claude: option A adds GBP 8.24 a month; A-lite GBP 5.84; blocked GBP 0. Daily chat caps bound the busy month.
Region: London costs GBP 0.46 a month more than Virginia; not a lever for fit.
